# function: to_unicode

Returns the Unicode form of a domain name: `xn--mnchen-3ya.de` is `münchen.de`. The name is checked like in `to_ascii` first, so an invalid `xn--` label fails instead of passing through.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# "münchen.de"
output "zone" {
  value = provider::idna::to_unicode("xn--mnchen-3ya.de")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
to_unicode(name string) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `name` (String) A domain name or a name in a zone: `münchen.de`, `www.bücher`, `_acme-challenge.münchen.de`, `*.münchen.de`, `münchen.de.` or `@`.
